basic_info.description: A true Noe Valley gem. 61 Homestead's curb appeal can only be outdone by its ideal floor plan, vaulted ceilings, natural light, fabulous views, and a one of a kind, large mature garden. The main level features a light-filled open remodeled kitchen, a formal living room with a wood burning fireplace and a sophisticated dining area. The upstairs includes three bedrooms, one full bath, and is highlighted by the large primary bedroom with vaulted ceilings and spectacular views. The lower level  provides a flexible floor plan with a study open to a light filled family room below, a Tahoe worthy office, and a full bath. The nano doors lead to the spectacular mature garden and patio, offering indoor/outdoor living at its finest.
